row: Jutta Shelter is a non-profit animal shelter in Ierapetra Crete. We rescue and take care of stray animals. We  give these animals a better future by offering them for adoption. The backbone of our ethics is to defend animal's rights and their freedom. We are also against unnecessary euthanasia of healthy animals. We receive NO government funding and rely entirely on donations.
